details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:432-435 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_FIXUP_ISSUES=10` silently truncates legitimate fix-up issues when diagnosis returns more than 10.
  WHY: All reviewers identified the same truncation bug, and the highest reported severity/confidence is high/5.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:125-138 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `FAILED_STEP_NAME` extraction drops the `in_progress` fallback, so cancelled runs can resolve to `unknown-step`.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the refactor no longer checks `in_progress`; severity varies from low to medium, so the highest is used.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:40-56 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_safe_gh_jq` path lacks the retry logic present in the real helper.
  WHY: The same robustness gap was reported by multiple reviewers, with low severity and low-to-medium confidence.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:494-506 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Dependency notes for fix-up issues beyond the cap are skipped, leaving incomplete dependency tracking.
  WHY: Reviewers described the same cap-induced omission, with medium severity and up to confidence 4.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:17 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `JOB_STATUS` is passed/documented but never consumed by the script.
  WHY: Both reviewers flagged the unused input; severity was not explicitly stated by one reviewer, so the highest reported severity is used.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:end of file | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The script ends without an explicit `exit 0`.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers flagged the same brittleness concern, but only low confidence was reported.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:147-152 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: An unreadable first commit can cause early exit with `ADVANCE=unknown` without checking later commits.
  WHY: Two reviewers reported the same early-exit behavior with low confidence.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2602 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow invokes the diagnose script without separately verifying that bootstrap staging completed successfully.
  WHY: This was only reported by one reviewer and remains a single-reviewer finding.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:335-339 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `extract_last_json_with_key` may fail on responses with surrounding or trailing text around fenced JSON.
  WHY: Single-reviewer parse-robustness concern with low confidence.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:354 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The extracted script is present in the bootstrap list, resolving the previously reported missing-file issue.
  WHY: This reviewer treated the now-fixed bootstrap state as a verified finding, and no other reviewer reported the same item as a bug.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: Cache restore/save steps are present, so the earlier missing-cache concern is not a current bug.
  WHY: This is a single-reviewer verification-style item and does not duplicate another reported bug.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:105 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: `ensure_implementation_failed_label` is called redundantly in loop-failure paths.
  WHY: Only one reviewer reported this redundancy, so it remains a singleton finding.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:432-435 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The hard-coded `MAX_FIXUP_ISSUES=10` cap truncates legitimate fix-up issues when the diagnose returns more than 10 issues.
  WHY: The original behavior created all requested issues, but the new cap silently drops excess work.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:494-506 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The dependency-resolution loop silently skips dependency notes for fix-up issues that were capped out earlier.
  WHY: Dependencies for issues beyond the 10-item cap are never processed, leaving incomplete tracking.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:678-680 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PR_NUMBER` defaults to `0`, which can cause multiple PRs to share the same `pr-0.txt` ledger file.
  WHY: The `0` default creates a collision namespace for all PRs without an explicit `PR_NUMBER`.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:40-56 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_safe_gh_jq` implementation does not include the retry logic present in the real helper.
  WHY: Transient API failures are more likely to fail in the fallback path.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:125-138 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new `FAILED_STEP_NAME` logic does not include `in_progress` as a fallback for cancellations.
  WHY: When a job is cancelled while a step is still running, the diagnostic may show `unknown-step`.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:311-360 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The Python JSON extraction expects fenced code blocks to be at the very beginning and end of the file.
  WHY: Extra text before or after the fenced JSON may cause parsing failure where the original regex approach succeeded.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:end of file | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The script has no explicit `exit 0` at the end.
  WHY: The implicit success contract is brittle if future edits change the last command's exit behavior.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2598 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: `JOB_STATUS` is passed from the workflow but not used in the script.
  WHY: It is dead code with no functional impact.
- scripts/check_external_branch_advance.sh:147-152 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If the first commit in the range has an unreadable subject, the script exits with `ADVANCE=unknown` without checking later commits.
  WHY: Early exit on the first unreadable commit can hide a later readable commit that should trigger `external` detection.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:354 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The extracted script `implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh` is now successfully staged in the support-files bootstrap step in `implement.yml`, resolving the high-severity missing-file error identified by previous reviewers.
  WHY: I verified in the `last_run_diff.patch` (lines 8-10) that the script was added to the staging loop.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The consensus finding that cache steps are missing was actually addressed in the full PR set.
  WHY: The PR description and `AGENTS.md` confirm that the ledger now uses `actions/cache/restore` and `actions/cache/save` for persistence.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:125-138 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `FAILED_STEP_NAME` logic has been hardened to include `cancelled`, `timed_out`, and `action_required` states, but it does indeed lack the `in_progress` fallback present in some other parts of the codebase.
  WHY: If no step matches the failed/cancelled/timeout/action_required criteria, it defaults to `unknown-step`, which can happen when a job is cancelled before a step transitions.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:105 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Redundant `ensure_implementation_failed_label` calls in loop-failure paths.
  WHY: The function is called inside the `needs_fixes` case and again at the end of the `harness_error`, `infeasible`, and `*` cases.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh (lines 125-138) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new extraction logic checks for failure, cancelled, timed_out, action_required conclusions but does NOT check for `.status == "in_progress"` that the original inline code had.
  WHY: When a cancellation occurs where the failing step was still running, the new logic returns `unknown-step` while the original would have identified the running step.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh (line 432) | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hard-coded `MAX_FIXUP_ISSUES=10` silently truncates legitimate fix-up issues when the LLM returns more than 10.
  WHY: The original inline behavior created all requested issues without a cap.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh (end of file) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The script ends with a `esac` and no explicit `exit 0`.
  WHY: The implicit success contract is brittle if future edits change the last command's behavior.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh (lines 494-506) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `MAX_FIXUP_ISSUES` caps the issue count, the dependency-resolution loop silently skips dependency notes for the truncated issues.
  WHY: References to skipped fix-ups remain unexplained in the comments.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh (lines 40-56) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The fallback `_safe_gh_jq` function lacks the retry logic present in the real `gh_helpers.sh` implementation.
  WHY: This can make transient API failures more likely in the fallback path.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml (around line 2602) | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `JOB_STATUS` is passed into the diagnose script via env but is not read inside the script.
  WHY: This is dead code and indicates incomplete implementation, though it does not affect runtime.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2602 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The workflow invokes `bash scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh` without separately verifying the script file exists after bootstrap staging.
  WHY: If bootstrap fails partially, the step fails with a file-not-found error rather than degrading gracefully.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:17 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `JOB_STATUS` is documented as a required input but is never consumed in the script logic.
  WHY: The original inline step used `job.status` to determine when to apply cancellation-aware `FAILED_STEP_NAME` fallback logic.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:end of file | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The script lacks an explicit `exit 0` at the end.
  WHY: Future edits could make the implicit success contract fail if the last command changes behavior.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:432-435 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `MAX_FIXUP_ISSUES=10` cap silently truncates legitimate fix-up issues returned by diag
